name: Welterman International Limited
about: Welterman International Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of fertilizers in India. It offers inorganic water-soluble chemical fertilizers. The company also manufactures leather soles, rubber soles, TPR, TPU and PVC soles, specialized injected soles, and leather soles with masonite heels. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Vadodara, India.
